constraints.name: bookings_status_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((status)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['pending'::character varying, 'confirmed'::character varying, 'in_progress'::character varying, 'completed'::character varying, 'cancelled'::character varying])::text[])))

constraints.name: complaints_status_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((status)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['open'::character varying, 'reviewing'::character varying, 'resolved'::character varying, 'dismissed'::character varying])::text[])))

constraints.name: job_applications_status_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((status)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['pending'::character varying, 'accepted'::character varying, 'rejected'::character varying])::text[])))

constraints.name: jobs_status_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((status)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['open'::character varying, 'in_progress'::character varying, 'completed'::character varying, 'cancelled'::character varying])::text[])))

constraints.name: payments_status_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((status)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['pending'::character varying, 'completed'::character varying, 'refunded'::character varying])::text[])))

constraints.name: reviews_rating_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((rating >= 1) AND (rating <= 5)))

constraints.name: users_role_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((role)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['household'::character varying, 'helper'::character varying, 'admin'::character varying])::text[])))
